report_generation: Original five analysis files copied byte-for-byte from measure.py/report.py outputs. population_coverage.csv selects invariant per-population case counts from metadata.json; cache_and_memory.csv aggregates case maxima from audit.json and metadata.json. summary.png and per_request.png render the original same-named SVGs at intrinsic dimensions via librsvg/cairo. summary_readable.svg/png are generated from the verified summary JSON by the separately recorded Matplotlib renderer.
interpretation: Counts are a bounded heat-weighted sample of the population, not a mandatory pass over all users.
All revisits hit whole-user prefix sessions; capacity benefits are not established by this 4K trace.
CUDA allocator peaks include all live allocations and retained allocator blocks; they are not isolated cache or physical process peaks.
16K/64K are pending; separate 4K native overlap profiling is published as layer-31 mechanism evidence only.

supplemental_renderer.changes: Categorical user-population x spacing and independent all/revisit y axes. Means/p95 read directly from verified summary.json.

derived_tables.population_coverage.csv: Per-population requests/observed_users/revisits/max_revisits_observed from metadata cases; assert all model/scheme cases agree. first_visits equals observed_users.
derived_tables.cache_and_memory.csv: Per model/scheme maximum of each audit.case_audit.peaks field and metadata.cases GPU allocator peaks over seven populations; admission capacity and per-session reservations from audit. Evictions/revisit misses sum over the seven cases.

visual_inspection.raw_summary_limitation: Original numeric x-axis 1/8 labels overlap and common model y scale compresses revisits; raw audited file preserved. Supplemental summary resolves presentation issues.

formal_source_comparison.reason: Only the post-run profile entry point and its CPU tests may differ. Neither is executed by the formal latency measurement. Saved formal copies are verified against its manifest; current diagnostic copies have their own profile snapshot. All other formal sources, including performance/runtime code, must be unchanged.

profile.scope: Layer 31, first three revisits of the chosen saved NOSA population, one sample each
